# Placemein

> Placemein is an AI-driven campus placement and off-campus hiring platform based in Hyderabad, India. It connects colleges, companies, and students to streamline recruitment, placements, and employability outcomes.

## About

Placemein HR Solutions helps colleges automate their placement processes, assists companies in reaching qualified fresh talent across India, and empowers students to get placed faster through structured off-campus drives and training.

- Founded in Hyderabad, Telangana, India
- Focus: Campus placements, off-campus hiring drives, talent acquisition, EdTech
- Target users: Training & Placement Officers (TPOs), HR teams, fresh graduates and students

## Core Offerings

- https://www.placemein.com/students
- https://www.placemein.com/colleges
- https://www.placemein.com/hiring
- https://www.placemein.com/partners

## Key Features

- Automated on-campus and off-campus drive management
- Student assessment and shortlisting tools
- Recruiter–college matchmaking
- Placement reporting and analytics for TPOs
- Bulk communication tools for placement teams
